summary: User transferred 20 USDT on TON to COCA Wallet and found that swapping was unsupported and withdrawal required 0.2 TON for network fees. The USDT remained visible in the wallet and on chain.
user_mistake: Deposited USDT without holding TON required for network fees
prevention: Keep enough native TON to pay network fees before transferring tokens to a self custody wallet / Check asset and withdrawal requirements before depositing
